tasks.description: Split backend/src/routes/invoices.ts into focused modules (pulled forward from plan §7)
tasks.context:
File: backend/src/routes/invoices.ts (1173 lines, plan §M3-CQ-03 target ≤300)

This refactor is a PREREQUISITE for M1-MONEY-05 and M1-MONEY-06, both of which need surgical edits to invoices.ts that MiniMax cannot produce reliably on a file this size (confirmed: 3 destructive-rewrite attempts across sessions).

Extract to:
  - services/invoice-query.ts  (list/search/stats endpoint handlers)
  - services/invoice-mapper.ts  (mapInvoice helper + SELECT_FIELDS constant)
  - services/invoice-validator.ts  (paymentDetails schema, chain validation)
  - services/invoice-state-machine.ts  (VALID_TRANSITIONS map + transition-handler with PaymentEvent recording from M1-MONEY-02)

Behavior must be identical — supervisor rejects any endpoint shape change. Existing tests must pass unchanged.

Acceptance: backend/src/routes/invoices.ts ≤ 300 lines. All existing tests PASS. One new test file services/__tests__/invoice-state-machine-unit.test.ts exercises the extracted state-machine in isolation.

tasks.description: Webhook HMAC verification on delivery (resumed from week-116)
tasks.context:
DEFERRED from week-116 per DIR-005. New-file task, agent-tractable.

Files: backend/src/routes/webhooks.ts, backend/src/services/webhook-dispatcher.ts (new)

Change: On outbound delivery, compute HMAC-SHA256(secret, body) and send as X-Invoica-Signature: t=<ts>,v1=<hex>. On POST /v1/webhooks/:id/test receive-path, verify signature using crypto.timingSafeEqual. Document in docs-site/webhook-signatures.md.

Acceptance: Tampered body fails verification; replayed timestamp older than 5 min fails.

review.summary: Multiple critical issues: incomplete files, missing implementation, no signature verification in test endpoint, and missing Zod validation

issues.description: File is incomplete - cuts off mid-function in the stats endpoint implementation
File is incomplete - missing generateSignature method, sanitizeUrl method, calculateDelay method, and delay method that are referenced but not implemented
Missing the required POST /v1/webhooks/:id/test endpoint that should verify signatures using crypto.timingSafeEqual as specified in task
No Zod validation on API inputs - using manual validation instead of proper schema validation
Missing proper error handling - no custom error types, generic catch blocks
Test doesn't actually verify signature verification logic - only tests that signature header is present with correct format
Documentation is incomplete - cuts off mid-sentence and doesn't provide implementation examples

strengths: Correct HMAC-SHA256 signature verification logic in verifyWebhookSignature function
Proper use of crypto.timingSafeEqual for timing-safe comparison

tasks.context:

tasks.description: Persist VAT validation evidence to Supabase — EU 7-year retention compliance
tasks.context:
External audit 2026-04-24 flagged: backend/src/services/tax/vat-validator.ts stores validation evidence in an in-memory Map (line 46, `private evidenceStore: Map<string, TaxEvidence>`). Evidence is wiped on every PM2 restart. The store method has a commented-out line 162: `// await this.saveEvidenceToDatabase(evidence);`.

EU VAT legal retention is typically 7 years. For any real EU customer this is a compliance blocker. Not acute today (zero EU customers per invoice triage) but required before M2 gate.

Change: create Supabase migration 008_vat_evidence.sql with a VatEvidence table (id uuid PK, invoiceId text FK, vatNumber text, countryCode text, isValid bool, validatedAt timestamptz, evidenceJson jsonb, createdAt timestamptz DEFAULT now()). Wire the existing `storeEvidence()` method to INSERT into it. Keep the in-memory Map as an L1 cache if desired, but the source of truth must be Supabase.

Acceptance: backend restart does not lose any evidence row. Test covers: store → restart simulation (new VatValidator instance) → retrieve evidence → present.

review.summary: Critical implementation incomplete - VatValidator file is truncated mid-function, missing core persistence methods, and lacks proper error handling. Migration and tests are well-structured but cannot function without complete service implementation.

issues.description: File is truncated at line 148 inside normalizeVatNumber method - missing storeEvidence(), getEvidence(), and other core methods required by the task spec and tests
Missing storeEvidence() method implementation that should INSERT into vat_evidence table - this is the core requirement of the task
Missing getEvidence() method that tests expect to exist for evidence retrieval
Supabase client initialization lacks proper error handling - should throw or log meaningful errors when credentials missing
References system_logs table in cleanup function without ensuring it exists - could cause migration failure
Tests mock Supabase but don't verify the actual SQL schema matches the expected interface

strengths: Migration SQL is well-structured with proper indexes, comments, and RLS policies
Includes 7-year retention logic as required by EU VAT compliance
Test cases cover the key scenarios including restart simulation
Good separation of concerns with dedicated test file
Migration includes helpful cleanup function for retention management

tasks.description: Live on-chain Skale Base integration test (Scope 2 follow-up to 2026-04-22 API-layer smoke test)
tasks.context:
Scope 1 (API-layer smoke test) passed 2026-04-22: invoice creation with chain='skale', DE VAT 19% applied, PaymentEvents UNIQUE gate blocks replay. Mock txHash only.

Scope 2 (this task): real USDC transfer on Skale Base (mainnet 1187947933 or testnet-Sepolia 324705682), scanned by the EVM settlement detector, invoice auto-transitions to SETTLED via the real on-chain event.

Files to create:
  - scripts/test-skale-onchain.ts — test harness that:
      * reads 2 wallet private keys from .env (TEST_WALLET_A_PK, TEST_WALLET_B_PK) — owner funds these before running
      * creates an invoice via API with Wallet B's address as paymentAddress
      * signs and submits a USDC transfer from Wallet A to Wallet B on Skale Base
      * calls the settlement detector programmatically (or waits for PM2 settlement-poller) to confirm detection
      * verifies PaymentEvents row is written with the REAL on-chain txHash (not mock)
      * verifies Invoice.status transitions to SETTLED
  - docs/engineering/skale-onchain-test-setup.md — owner-facing runbook:
      * how to generate 2 fresh wallets (viem or ethers)
      * how to fund them with gasless compute credits on Skale Base (pre-paid compute credits per Skale docs)
      * how to acquire USDC on Skale Base (bridge from Base via Skale portal, or use Skale Base Sepolia testnet USDC faucet for first run)
      * how to run the harness and interpret output

Acceptance: one clean run (testnet OR mainnet) where a real on-chain USDC transfer on Skale Base is detected by Invoica's settlement detector and auto-marks an invoice SETTLED. Attach the txHash + block explorer link to the task note on completion.

Dependencies: none (chain config for Skale Base already live in main per commit 8c3ea35). Ideal to run BEFORE any marketing with Skale (for truth-in-capability).
